name: Long Beach Towne Center
summary: Long Beach Towne Center is an open-air lifestyle destination featuring 50+ national retailers, restaurants, and a movie theater in Long Beach, California. The center serves as a community hub with seasonal entertainment including popular summer concerts, offering a convenient one-stop shopping and dining experience.
demographics: Long Beach Towne Center attracts a diverse, middle-income demographic primarily from the surrounding Long Beach and South Bay communities. The trade area serves families with household incomes ranging from $50,000 to $100,000, with a strong representation of millennials and Gen X shoppers aged 25-54. The center draws both local residents seeking convenient shopping and dining options as well as regional visitors attracted to its entertainment offerings. Shopping patterns reflect a preference for value-oriented national retailers combined with casual dining experiences, with peak traffic during evenings and weekends when families visit for combined shopping and entertainment outings.
description: Long Beach Towne Center stands as a premier open-air lifestyle destination in the heart of Long Beach, California, offering visitors a dynamic blend of shopping, dining, and entertainment experiences. With over 50 chain stores and restaurants spread across its thoughtfully designed outdoor layout, the center has become a cornerstone of the local retail landscape since its development. The property features a diverse tenant mix that caters to everyday needs and leisure activities, anchored by popular national retailers and complemented by a full-service movie theater that draws crowds throughout the week. Beyond traditional shopping, Long Beach Towne Center has cultivated a community gathering place atmosphere, hosting summer concert series that bring together residents and visitors for outdoor entertainment. Its convenient location on Carson Boulevard, combined with ample parking and pedestrian-friendly walkways, makes it an accessible and welcoming destination for families, young professionals, and shoppers throughout the greater Long Beach area.
